title: not what I was hoping for--won't fit many kitchen cabinets
text: not what I was hoping for--won't fit many kitchen cabinets. Did not fit on my cabinets with a beveled edge.  Unless you have really thick, squarish-edged cabinets this will not work for you.  It falls off almost immediately if I try to hang it.  I bet it would've worked on the old, cheap cabinets the house came with.  Any middle to high end stuff is probably not built to fit this

product_metadata.title: iDesign Axis Metal Over the Cabinet Paper Towel Bar for Kitchen, Pantry, Mudroom, 5.2" x 1.2" x 12", Bronze
features: OVER THE CABINET PAPER TOWEL HOLDER: Keep paper towels within arm's reach in your kitchen, bathroom, craft room, laundry room, garage, or workspace. No hardware required, simply hang over cabinet door
DURABLE: Rust-resistant stainless steel for long lasting use
STYLISH: Bronze finish is fashionable and matches a variety of kitchen decor styles
FOAM BACKING: Hooks include foam backing to protect cabinet doors from scratching or other damage. Requires no mounting hardware
IDEAL SIZE: Paper towel holder measures 5.2" x 1.2" x 12" for use in any kitchen. Hook fits cabinet doors between .65"-.75"
description: Add a classic look to your kitchen with the iDesign Axis Over the Cabinet Paper Towel Holder. Constructed of rust-resistant steel, this paper towel holder is built to last. With a stylish bronze finish, this paper towel dispenser will easily match any decor. The holder hangs easily over any standard cabinet door- no hardware or messy adhesives required! Foam backing on the hooks protects your cabinets from any scratches or damage. Use in your kitchen, pantry, mudroom, or laundry room to always have a towel within arm's reach. The iDesign Axis Over the Cabinet Paper Towel Holder measures 5.2" x 1.2" x 12", perfect for your home. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
